description: Use when preparing for Japan's Registered Information Security Specialist examination (情報処理安全確保支援士試験, SC) run by IPA — the multiple-choice parts (科目A-1 / A-2, formerly 午前I / 午前II) and the descriptive part (科目B, formerly 午後), exemptions, using IPA's published past papers, and turning hands-on security work into written answers. Also use when writing practice questions on web security, cryptography, network and incident response at this level.
